scope: ALB origin HTTPS health endpoint; direct-to-origin, Cloudflare not included
limitations: The test connected directly to the ALB origin while preserving the public hostname for TLS SNI and HTTP Host; it did not measure Cloudflare edge latency or filtering.
Only unauthenticated GET /health requests were generated; no orders, database mutations, or Azure events were created.
This small probe does not establish transaction throughput, autoscaling behavior, Multi-AZ failover, or capacity for 3000 concurrent users.
